lessons.title: Ancient Philosophical Roots: Plato & Aristotle
lessons.description: Explore early Greek inquiries into psyche, Plato's nativism and idealism vs Aristotle's empirical tabula rasa.

lessons.title: Mind-Body Dualism: René Descartes
lessons.description: Analyze substance dualism, res cogitans vs res extensa, the reflex arc, and pineal gland interactionism.

lessons.title: British Empiricism & Associationism: Locke & Hume
lessons.description: Understand Locke's tabula rasa, Hume's laws of association, and the epistemic shift toward sensory experience.

lessons.title: Physiology Meets Psychology: Helmholtz & Weber
lessons.description: Trace 19th-century advances in nerve conduction, psychophysics, just noticeable differences, and Weber's Law.
